scope: Automated spelling screening of the previous public release with source review of suspect categories.
rules: Exclude truncated given names ending in a full stop, isolated letter initials, honorific prefixes and ellipsis placeholders.
Exclude the US administrative given-name placeholders Noname and FNU.
Exclude Brazilian sex and missing-value labels when found in name fields.
Exclude the Vietnamese given-name value male, traced to the Wikidata sex item Q6581097.
